variants.v1_published: Find and read a repository's own agent rulebook (the AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md chain, nested files included) before editing, measuring, or reporting on anything inside it. Use this whenever work touches a user repo or granted host folder - running an ablation or benchmark, regrading runs, adding an experiment result, writing to an evidence ledger, registering a protocol, or opening a PR - and also for any task in a directory that might carry house rules. This matters because Claude Science does not auto-load CLAUDE.md the way Claude Code does, so a repo's rules are invisible here unless you go and read them, and a result produced in violation of them is not usable.
